page: Google Cloud Platform t2d-standard-8 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the Tau T2D machine family. It features 8 vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 7B13 processor using the x86_64 architecture. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each vCPU has dedicated physical execution resources. The instance is equipped with 32 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware.

Benchmark data indicates strong single-core CPU performance, placing in the top 25% of tested systems. Multi-core CPU performance, memory bandwidth, and compression tasks fall within the average range. Specifically, the instance achieves a single-core Geekbench score of 1455.0 and a multi-core score of 7817.0. Cryptographic and integer operations are supported by hardware-accelerated instructions including AES, VAES, and SHA_NI.

The lack of local NVMe storage and GPU accelerators limits this instance's utility for high-speed local database logging or heavy parallel graphics processing. However, its dedicated core architecture and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio make it suitable for general-purpose workloads such as web serving, application hosting, and moderate database operations.
